Main
The permissions demo opens the camera permission prompt so you can see how the result is reported.
The permissions demo asks for microphone access to show how the status changes after you answer.
Photo library access is requested to demonstrate the photos and limited-access statuses.
Music library access is requested to demonstrate the audio permission tag.
Location while the app is open is requested to demonstrate the location permission tag.
Background location is requested to demonstrate the two-step location always flow.
Contacts access is requested to demonstrate the contacts permission tag. Nothing is read or stored.
Full calendar access is requested to demonstrate the calendar permission tag. No events are read.
Calendar access is requested to demonstrate the calendar permission tag on older iOS versions.
Bluetooth access is requested to demonstrate the bluetooth permission tag. No devices are scanned.
Motion and fitness access is requested to demonstrate the motion permission tag.
Speech recognition is requested to demonstrate the speech permission tag. No audio is processed.
This demo asks for tracking permission only to show the App Tracking Transparency status. Nothing is tracked.
Full reminders access is requested to demonstrate the reminders permission tag.
Reminders access is requested to demonstrate the reminders permission tag on older iOS versions.
